questions.enonce: What are the three time horizons used in demand forecasting processes?
options: Short-term, medium-term, and long-term
Production cycle, commercial cycle, and financial cycle
Green zone, orange zone, and red zone
Level P1, P2, and P3
questions.explication: Demand forecasts are divided into three horizons: long-term (> 3 years for strategy), medium-term (6 months to 3 years for capacities), and short-term (< 6 months for loads and schedules)[span_0](start_span)[span_0](end_span).

questions.enonce: What is the main objective of medium-term demand forecasting (between 6 months and 3 years)?
options: Define the company's overall strategy and major investments
Help define the capacities and production means to be used (equipment, lines, personnel)
Set the schedules and workloads for the coming week
Manage only the physical transportation flows between suppliers
questions.explication: The medium-term helps define capacities and production means (equipment and human resources), whereas the long-term serves strategy and the short-term defines operational loads[span_1](start_span)[span_1](end_span).

questions.enonce: How many main types of demand are distinguished in market trend analysis?
options: 2 types (standard and specific)
3 types (simple, complex, random)
4 types (constant, with trend, seasonal, seasonal with trend)
5 types based on procurement BOMs
questions.explication: The course identifies four types of demand: constant demand, demand with a trend, seasonal demand, and seasonal demand with a trend (the most general case)[span_2](start_span)[span_2](end_span).

questions.enonce: What is the principle and objective of a Delphi study among qualitative methods?
options: Conduct a statistical survey among thousands of end customers
Conduct surveys with domain experts holding divergent viewpoints to help them build a consensus
Apply a linear regression on sales history in Excel
Estimate production costs from the retail price
questions.explication: The Delphi method consists of interviewing experts with sometimes conflicting opinions in order to guide them toward a qualitative consensus[span_3](start_span)[span_3](end_span).

questions.enonce: Which Excel functions are used to calculate the parameters of a linear regression (Y = aX + b) in English and French?
options: LINEST / DROITEREG for the slope (a) and INTERCEPT / ORDONNE.ORIGINE for the y-intercept (b)
AVERAGE / MOYENNE and SUM / SOMME
VLOOKUP / RECHERCHEV and INDEX
STDEV / ECARTYPE and VAR
questions.explication: For linear regression, LINEST (DROITEREG in French) is used for the slope and INTERCEPT (ORDONNE.ORIGINE in French) for the y-intercept[span_4](start_span)[span_4](end_span).
